authority: Actual Havok, Babylon NullEngine, fixed 120 Hz. No GPU/rendered frame/phone-performance claim.
lifecycle: Ball first-ground ends the flight and disables its collision masks. The passive stone continues in Havok; 60 quiet ticks (linear and angular speed each <=0.025) hold its measured pose between shots. Ten post-ball seconds without quiet blocks further fire and offers Undo/Reset. Held pre-shot state, pose-only at ball termination, and held settled state are separate. The terminal pose excludes dynamic prop velocities and is not a complete restart state. Holding the quiet measured pose discards the explicitly bounded residual speeds; it never relocates the prop. Recreate a fresh dynamic prop from the held pose only on manual fire; no motor or scripted movement.

comparison.note: Minimum mechanism comparison; carriage is one angled constrained reflector, not a completed V-prow. Different tuned prop behavior is explicit; neither changes the ball.
